# Sirach Chapter 46 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Codex Vaticanus, Sirach 46 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-DC/SIR_046_page_001.jpg

---

46:1 Joshua son of Nun was mighty in war, and was the successor of Moses in prophesying; who was, as his name declared, a great salvation for his elect, for vengeance against the enemies that rose up against them, so that he might give Israel its inheritance.

46:2 How glorified he was when he stretched out his hand and when he wielded the sword against the cities!

46:3 Who before him ever stood firm like this? For he himself waged the wars of the Lord.

46:4 Was it not by his hand that the sun stood still, and one day became as two days?

46:5 He called upon the Most High, the Mighty One, when enemies were pressing him on every side, and the great Lord answered him with hailstones of mighty power.

46:6 He overwhelmed a nation in battle, and on the descent he destroyed adversaries, so that the nations might know his armament — that he was fighting before the Lord; for he followed the Mighty One.

46:7 And also in the days of Moses he did a work of mercy — he and Caleb son of Jephunneh — in standing firm against the congregation, in holding back the people from sin, and in silencing the evil murmuring.

46:8 And out of six hundred thousand infantry, those two alone were preserved to bring them into their inheritance, into a land flowing with milk and honey.

46:9 And the Lord gave Caleb strength, and it remained with him into old age, so that he went up to the high places of the land, and his seed received it as an inheritance,

46:10 so that all the children of Israel might see that it is good to follow the Lord.

46:11 And also the judges — each one by his name — all whose hearts did not play the harlot and who did not turn away from the Lord — may their memory be for a blessing.

46:12 May their bones revive from where they lie, and may the name of those who were honored be renewed in their sons.

46:13 Samuel, beloved of his Lord, a prophet of the Lord, established the kingdom and anointed rulers over his people.

46:14 By the law of the Lord he judged the congregation, and the Lord watched over Jacob.

46:15 By his faithfulness he was known as a true prophet, and by his words he was seen as a trustworthy seer.

46:16 He called upon the Lord, the Mighty One, when enemies hemmed him in on every side, when he offered a suckling lamb.

46:17 And the Lord thundered from heaven, and with a great noise made his voice heard.

46:18 He crushed the leaders of the enemy and destroyed all the rulers of the Philistines.

46:19 Before the time of his eternal sleep, he bore witness before the Lord and his anointed: "I have not taken anyone's property, not even a pair of sandals" — and no man accused him.

46:20 And even after he had fallen asleep, he prophesied and revealed to the king his death, and lifted up his voice from the earth in prophecy, to blot out the wickedness of the people.
